body: - 2026-11-25: A case whose start must end before its session starts (a not-resumed or otherwise sessionless child) cannot go through `Wrapper::adopt` or any readiness-waiting test wrapper, which waits for a readiness that start never reaches: run the verb piped outside a terminal, as `tests/cli_up.rs`'s sessionless start does, and read stdout and stderr apart.

The session built the not-resumed end of viola adopt: when the resumed claude child ends before its session starts, adopt now refuses with a third refusal of its own, not-resumed, exit 1.
On a human terminal it prints the fixed pair «unable: <name>'s session did not resume» then «hint: check the session id - claude --resume <id> must open it by hand, under the same claude config»; under --json it prints exactly the document {"v":1,"error":"not-resumed","detail":null} with stderr empty.
That pair or document is written after the child ended and released the terminal, an exception scoped to adopt's not-resumed end alone; run and revive keep writing nothing past the child, and a pump error under adopt still prints no document.
The run diagnostics log gains the process-exit detail word not-resumed (self, exit 1), logged after the child's own process-exit; no session id appears in any line.
The fake claude agent gains the argv-only option --resume-absent, and the R5 adopt rig gains a start= field on r5a and a rehearse-only third verdict line r5c.
It measured the premise that adopt must start its child in the session's own folder false, so the spawn folder is unchanged; it claims no capability.

body:
The session built the not-resumed end of viola adopt: when the resumed claude child ends before its session starts, adopt now refuses with a third own refusal, not-resumed, and exits 1.
Adopt's start logs the child's process-exit (subject claude-child) and then one self process-exit with exit_code 1 and detail not-resumed; a resumed child still ends exit 0 with no detail.
The refusal is written after the child released the terminal: the fixed unable and hint pair on stderr, or under --json the document with error not-resumed and detail null.
The not-resumed criterion is the wrapper's own snapshot, read through replay: not resumed only when a real snapshot holds no agent session id; a replayed, absent or unreadable snapshot counts as resumed.
The diagnostic line schema's closed process-exit detail enum gains the word not-resumed; the fake agent gains the argv-only option --resume-absent; the R5 adopt rig gains a start field on r5a and a rehearse-only r5c line.
No event kind, subject, field, span, IPC method, env var or config key was added; run and revive keep their pump and exit mapping unchanged.

The strict-modes refusal of viola adopt and the adopt refusal order: not-resumed is a refusal written after the child ran and ended, not a start refusal before the spawn; a row saying every adopt refusal comes before the child starts now has an exception.

Refusals hold no paths, pids or ids and error messages interpolate nothing: the new not-resumed pair names the instance only and holds no session id, its hint names the literal word id; a row on these floors gains a case to hold.
Fixed error display messages and every product error writer named: a new fixed pair and its writer in adopt join the closed set, and the exit-1 cause table and error-body list each gain a row.
The process-exit detail word set, a closed enum: it gains not-resumed; a row whose cell lists the closed detail words or the exit-1 details of adopt now misses one.

Replayed snapshot is inert and its fallbacks: adopt now reads the instance snapshot through the snapshot-or-replay read to decide resumed, and a replayed, absent or unreadable snapshot is taken as resumed (exit 0), never a refusal.

Strict-modes check before the snapshot is read, snapshot reference values only after the strict-modes check, and state readers never write: adopt's new snapshot read happens after its start's checks and writes nothing; a row ruling over who reads the snapshot gains adopt's end-of-child read.

The internal-error path of adopt: a pump worker panic still logs internal-error and exits 1 with no --json document; a row on the catch-site internal error output keeps holding but now reaches adopt through the new end-of-child step.
Adopt acts on no process it did not start: the not-resumed end acts only on adopt's own child, which already ended; no signal to any foreign process.

R5 adopt script ends only its own processes: the rig gains a rehearse-only arm r5c over the fake agent that ends only what the script recorded, and r5a's verdict line gains a start= closed word; its live arms type what and where they typed before.

Test seams only under the fake-agent feature and compiled out of release, release build free of test-only features: the fake agent gains the argv-only option --resume-absent, inside the test-only binary.
Real claude CLI only locally and CI holds no real claude: the not-resumed end is proven on the fake agent alone; no real claude ran in the session or its CI.

The rule that a --json document is never written once the child held the terminal: adopt's not-resumed end writes its pair or document after the child released the terminal, an added named case scoped to adopt only, nothing of run or revive.

config.json keys, the board and viola list, link and unlink, send, answer and paste text checks: untouched.
viola revive's --json codes and its pump-child error contract, and viola run's own refusals: unchanged; the not-resumed exception is scoped to adopt alone.

The session built the not-resumed end of viola adopt: when the resumed claude child ends before its session starts (the wrapper's snapshot holds no agent session id), adopt exits 1 with a fixed unable/hint pair, or under --json the refused document with error not-resumed and detail null.
That end writes its pair or document after the child released the terminal, and logs a self process-exit with exit_code 1 and detail not-resumed after the child's process-exit{subject:"claude-child"}; a resumed child, or a replayed, absent or unreadable snapshot, still ends exit 0.
The child pump was split: a new pump end returns the child's end without writing a self exit; the run and revive pump keeps its signature and its mapping (exit 0, or internal-error exit 1) on top of it, and adopt no longer calls it.
The fake agent gained an argv-only option --resume-absent: with --resume it fires SessionEnd with no SessionStart, closes its hooks, ignores SIGHUP and exits 1.
The R5 adopt rig gained a start= field on its r5a verdict line and a rehearse-only third arm r5c over the fake agent; the session measured nothing live and no real claude ran, so the not-resumed end is proven on the fake agent alone.
It retired nothing; viola adopt's own refusals went from two to three, the adopt --json refusal codes from eight to nine, and the process-exit detail enum gained one word.

body: decision/fake-agent-argv-only: the fake agent's argv-only option list gains --resume-absent.

contract/fake-agent-cli/argv-only-options: the modes and options of the fake agent command line gain --resume-absent; no per-option row exists for it yet, while --stop-crons, --stop-reading, --transcript and --wake-after-ms each have one.
contract/fake-agent-exit/exit-triggers: a new exit trigger, --resume-absent with --resume, fires SessionEnd and exits 1 before any SessionStart.
contract/fake-agent-events/session-start: under --resume-absent with --resume the fake agent fires no SessionStart.
decision/fake-agent-exit-ignores-sighup: the new resume-absent exit also closes its hooks and ignores SIGHUP before exit 1, as the fake's other exits do.

decision/adopt-proven-live and decision/fake-agent-not-proof-of-real-cli: adopt's not-resumed end is proven over the fake agent alone; what the real CLI does with an id it cannot resume stays the gated live reading R5's, and no capability is claimed.

decision/revive-json-no-document-after-terminal and contract/revive-json/pump-child-error: the child pump now sits over a pump end; revive's mapping is unchanged and a pump error still prints no document, but adopt's not-resumed end now writes its pair or document after the child released the terminal, an adopt-scoped exception to writing nothing past the child.

decision/each-exit-cause-own-hint and decision/hint-names-its-cause: a new exit cause not-resumed with its own hint (check the session id, claude --resume with the id must open it by hand under the same claude config).

decision/error-writers-each-named, decision/error-bodies-held-by-surface-witnesses and decision/contract-tables-are-literal: the exit-1 cause table gains one row and the CLI document witness table gains one body, for not-resumed.
contract/cli-json-failure/document and decision/cli-json-one-document: viola adopt --json gains a ninth refusal code, not-resumed, written as one refused document with detail null and stderr empty.
decision/diagnostics-schema-conformance and decision/closed-enums-need-decisions-log: the closed process-exit detail enum of the diagnostics line schema gains the word not-resumed.

contract/log-event-corr/process-exit and contract/process-start/claude-child: a not-resumed adopt logs process-start and process-exit of the claude child, then a self process-exit exit_code 1 detail not-resumed.
decision/cli-fixed-strings-pinned-by-literal and decision/cli-outputs-pinned-by-literal: the not-resumed unable and hint pair is pinned by a literal in the adopt suite.

decision/snapshot-read-through-replay and decision/replayed-snapshot-has-no-endpoint: adopt's resumed check reads the instance snapshot through read-or-replay once, and treats a replayed, absent or unreadable snapshot as resumed; only a real snapshot without an agent session id is not resumed.

decision/child-exit-read-on-the-process-handle and decision/exit-detected-on-handle: the pump end that reports the child's end is the same handle wait, now returned to the caller before any self exit is written.

decision/standing-live-rig, decision/refusal-rehearsal-reads-own-effects and decision/kr-seams-rehearse-only: the R5 rig gains a rehearse-only arm r5c reading the refusal's own effects (not-resumed, child started, child ended) and a start= field on r5a read from the last self process-exit detail.
decision/logs-carry-no-secrets and decision/secrets-never-in-logs: the not-resumed pair and lines hold the instance name only; the session id is asserted absent from every line.

decision/wrapper-drop-guard and decision/wrapper-spawned-with-guard: the not-resumed cases cannot use the readiness-waiting test wrapper and run viola adopt piped in a test-owned home outside any terminal.
decision/real-claude-local-only, decision/no-real-cli-in-ci and decision/live-verify-never-in-ci: the session ran no real claude and the R5 rig only under its rehearsal.

body_fields.fact: The fake agent option --resume-absent (argv-only): given with --resume, the fake fires SessionEnd with no SessionStart, closes its hooks, ignores SIGHUP and exits 1, at both launch sites (a trusted start and the trust dialog's accept).

viola adopt exit 1 cause not-resumed: the child ended without its session starting, so adopt writes the unable line naming the instance and its own hint on stderr, or under --json the refused document not-resumed with detail null, after the child released the terminal, and logs a self process-exit detail not-resumed after the child's process-exit.
Adopt's not-resumed end is proven only over the fake agent; the real CLI's end for an id it cannot resume is read only by the gated live reading R5.
The R5 adopt rig's arm r5c runs only under rehearse over the fake agent, and r5a's verdict line ends start= the last self process-exit detail or ok, its green rule unchanged.
A test whose start must end before a session starts runs the verb piped outside a terminal, never through the readiness-waiting test wrapper, reading stdout and stderr apart.
